opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: The British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowships is a three year award made to an annual cohort of outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences. The Fellowship is non-renewable and funded by the Department for Science, Innovation & Technology (DSIT).

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral or equivalent researchers with a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO.
opportunities.summary: The Talent Development Awards are available to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers. The scheme supports innovative research methods, skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral or above researchers from the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research institute.
opportunities.summary: The programme supports projects that engage with questions concerning the relationship between expertise, public understanding and policy delivery internationally, highlighting the importance of collaboration between communities of practice, disciplines, capacities and borders.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early- and mid-career researchers from the humanities and social sciences based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: The Global Innovation Fellowships provide opportunities for UK-based researchers to develop their skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors to address challenges that require innovative approaches and solutions.
